_sobre: Format example of the typing text, with no brand: 16:9, one request typed into the field and the product's answer as a card (title, tags and three lines that write themselves), then the closing with the logo alone, centered. No border, no shadow, no glow; the block grows slowly ('respira'). Greys, placeholder texts and the placeholder logo stand for the person's brand and content: swap them. Render: node scripts/example-fonts.mjs <output>/.work-typing-text-example && node templates/typing-text/render.mjs templates/typing-text/example.json --out <output> --mode draft

cenas.texto: Your request, as the person would type it

linhas: First, what the product does with the request.
Then, how it builds the answer and checks the result.
